notes: Retrained checkpoint, not the released one: the trajectory generator retrained on Physical AI AV train, behind the native AlpaSim driver at 0.1.7 (tools/models/drivejepa/alpasim_driver). The driver's log names the weights by label only (retrained generator with the first run's scorer, batch fix on, bonnet mask 37 rows, acceleration zeroed); it does not record the checkpoint's hash, so this row cannot prove which file drove. Adapted, not zero-shot: these ten scenes are the first ten of a 30-scene sweep and were also driven while the driver was developed. See docs/models/drivejepa.md.
